selfHostedHintCloudText: Seatsurfing is also available as a hosted SaaS solution with advanced features such as Microsoft Teams integration, Microsoft Exchange synchronization, and the SCIM 2.0 server.
selfHostedHintPlusText: The Plus plugin adds advanced features to your own installation, such as Microsoft Teams integration, Microsoft Exchange synchronization, and the SCIM 2.0 server.
selfHostedHintSponsorText: Seatsurfing is open source and developed in the open. Our sponsors support the ongoing development and keep the project independent.
